topic: Correction to r275 backlog oaq_pandemic_keys_unlisted: five 2021 Zonal Virtual URLs are named Respuestas_Zonal_NI/N1/N2/N2B/N3_2021.pdf, even though HTML anchors only say Nivel; these are answer resources, not five task statements. Identify actual 2021 question sheets separately and reconcile earlier assumptions.

OAQ r281 official historical HTML includes national Nivel 3E Enunciado for 2017, 2018 and 2019, but visible index/shard does not show paired 3E Respuestas; 3N has answers. Search original organizer years and lawful historical mirrors; do not assert definitive absence.

In resource_000281 2022 national level 3N tasks/answers are visible, but 3E entry is not present. Determine whether level 3E was held, published elsewhere, or represented by a different name; this is a coverage uncertainty.

County excellence centre HTML lists subject and marking rubrics for selected 2019–2021 grades and rounds, but years after 2021, earlier editions and full county/national coverage remain unverified. Distinguish original national contest tasks from center admission tests.

Organizer HTML lists proposed 2025 exams for primary grade 6 and secondary grades 1–2; no answer keys or earlier years were confirmed in the inspected documents index. Verify official editions and possible linked local mirrors.

University page lists astronomy Olympiad editions 2014, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2019. Presence of papers, solutions, stages and years 2016/2020+ is not established by the landing page; inspect linked HTML edition pages only.

Korean Chemical Society official page links '대회문제 및 풀이' to /board/17/list, but HTML text retrieval returned an empty text/plain representation. Treat as unknown content/access behavior, not proof of no past problems and not permission to bypass restrictions.

Raw occurrence for 2020 national virtual Nivel Inicial has title 'OAQ - Nacional 202020 - Inicial' while URL and organizer heading indicate 2020; avoid propagating typo as a separate competition year. Confirm normalization by URL and heading.
